explication: Terragrunt orchestrates Terraform/OpenTofu configurations: a user invokes a CLI command, configuration is parsed and units discovered, dependencies determine execution order, and units run with downloaded sources and an IaC engine. Results and outputs support downstream units. The repository also exposes catalog, MCP, remote-state bootstrap, and provider-cache capabilities. The README identifies the product but does not detail these subsystems; paths and relationships below use the supplied tree and sampled source, so unsampled wiring is left out.
